#### **1. Who Said What (Sort by Date & Time)**

- **[Sheri Johnson] (Distinguished Professor of Psychology, University of California Berkeley) – [September 10, 2024]:**
  - Reported a bug where the app disappears when clicking on the mood survey.
  - *Key quote:* "Hmmm... I and two other pilot participants are experiencing a bug, in which when we click on the mood survey to complete, the app disappears from the screen."

- **[Mojtaba Javan] (Support, Avicenna Research) – [September 11, 2024, 3:41 AM]:**
  - Requested participant IDs and device information to debug the issue.
  - *Key quote:* "Would you please share the ID and device (Android or iOS) of those two participants so we can check the issue deeply?"

- **[Sheri Johnson] (Distinguished Professor of Psychology, University of California Berkeley) – [September 11, 2024]:**
  - Provided device details (iPhone 15 Pro, iOS 17.6.1) and cc'd Carter and Lance for their device info.
  - *Key quote:* "Thanks so much. I am using an iphone 15 pro, ios 17.6.1. I am cc'ing Carter and Lance so they can share their phone info."

- **[Carter Bower] (Participant, University of California Berkeley) – [September 11, 2024, 9:01 AM]:**
  - Shared device details (iPhone XR, iOS 17.6.1).
  - *Key quote:* "Hi everyone, I’m using a iPhone XR with iOS 17.6.1."

- **[Lance J Kriegsfeld] (Participant, University of California Berkeley) – [September 11, 2024, 9:22 AM]:**
  - Shared device details (iPhone 15 Pro max, iOS 18.1 beta).
  - *Key quote:* "Hi all, I’m using an iPhone 15 Pro max on 18.1 beta."

- **[Omid Dolatkia] (Support, Avicenna Research) – [September 11, 2024]:**
  - Identified the issue and announced a new iOS app version release by the end of the next day.
  - Advised removing empty answer choices temporarily.
  - *Key quote:* "We have identified the issue, and a new version of the iOS app will be released by the end of tomorrow."

- **[Mohammad Hashemian] (Support, Avicenna Research) – [September 11, 2024, 12:04 PM]:**
  - Clarified the issue with empty answer options and confirmed support for the desired survey format.
  - *Key quote:* "You can of course use Single Answer question (radio button) for this purpose."

- **[Sheri Johnson] (Distinguished Professor of Psychology, University of California Berkeley) – [September 11, 2024, 11:12 AM]:**
  - Reported that the app is still crashing despite re-downloading the survey.
  - *Key quote:* "Sorry to say the app is still crashing. I tried re-downloading the study survey."

- **[Mohammad Hashemian] (Support, Avicenna Research) – [September 11, 2024, 2:32 PM]:**
  - Clarified that the iOS app update would take a day or two and advised waiting for the update.
  - *Key quote:* "We had to make a change to the iOS app and update the version in the App Store to support the empty content."

- **[Omid Dolatkia] (Support, Avicenna Research) – [September 11, 2024, 10:34 PM]:**
  - Announced the release of the new iOS app version (v895).
  - *Key quote:* "The new version of the Avicenna iOS app (v895) has been released."

- **[Sheri Johnson] (Distinguished Professor of Psychology, University of California Berkeley) – [September 12, 2024]:**
  - Confirmed successful survey completion after updating the app.
  - *Key quote:* "Success! Just completed a survey and it went smoothly."

#### **2. Timeline**
- **[September 10, 2024]:** Sheri Johnson reports app crash issue.
- **[September 11, 2024]:** Mojtaba Javan requests device details. Sheri, Carter, and Lance provide device info.
- **[September 11, 2024]:** Omid Dolatkia identifies the issue and announces a fix.
- **[September 11, 2024]:** Mohammad Hashemian confirms support for the survey format.
- **[September 11, 2024]:** Sheri reports ongoing crashes.
- **[September 11, 2024]:** Mohammad advises waiting for the app update.
- **[September 11, 2024]:** Omid announces the release of the new app version.
- **[September 12, 2024]:** Sheri confirms the issue is resolved.

#### **3. Key Events/Issues**
- **Issue 1:** App crashes when clicking on the mood survey.
  - **Resolution:** Identified as an issue with empty answer options in single-choice questions. Fixed in iOS app update v895.
- **Feedback Submission:** Sheri provided detailed feedback and device information.
- **Access/Login Issues:** No login issues reported; the problem was specific to survey interaction.

#### **4. Action Items**
- **Pending:**
  - None (all issues resolved).
- **Completed:**
  - Debugging the app crash issue.
  - Updating the iOS app to support empty answer options.
  - Testing the updated app.

#### **5. Technical Details**
- **Account/Login Info:** Not applicable.
- **Study ID/Project Code:** Study ID: 4069, Survey ID: 22694.

#### **6. Next Steps**
- **Action 1:** Inform pilot participants about the app update (assigned to Sheri Johnson).
- **Action 2:** Monitor for any further issues post-update (assigned to Avicenna Research support team).
